授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
To discuss the fundamental principles and applications of soil mechanics, construction material mechanics, structural mechanics, and hydraulics through experiments and observations.
Method: Short lecture, experiment, and report
Lecture topics:
1. Soil
- Particle size analysis, Soil classification, Compression test, Consolidation test, etc. -
2. Concrete
- Sieve analysis of aggregates, Fresh properties of concrete, Strength test, etc. -
3. Behavior of fluid
- Laminar flow, Turbulent flow, Hydraulic jump, Overflow, etc. -
Laboratory work
